cli.help.title: lanekit <command> [--lang ko|en]
cli.help.init: init     put guidance templates, decision records and gate scripts into the project
cli.help.doctor: doctor   check plugin installs, copied files, gate wiring and guidance size
cli.help.update: update   replace the copied files with the new version
cli.command-missing: This install has no file for the {command} command. Reinstall the plugin
init.plan.offers: Reference files placed in the suggestions folder
init.plan.legend: + write · = already the same · ? exists, so it is left alone and the proposed content goes to the suggestions folder
init.blocked: Not written: {path}. It is a symbolic link, points outside the repository, or a file sits where a folder is needed
init.module-missing: Module `{name}` has no files in this install, so it is not copied
init.dry-run: Nothing has been written yet. Run again with the same arguments and --yes to write
init.suggested: Existing files left untouched (the proposed content is at the path on the right)
init.lanekeeper.created: Created the lanekeeper config and filled in the gate command, release gate, lane commit and paths: {path}
init.lanekeeper.linked: The lanekeeper config already has the lanekit values: {path}
init.lanekeeper.suggested: The lanekeeper config exists, so it was not changed. A copy with the missing keys filled in is at {path}
init.lanekeeper.unavailable: The lanekeeper command is not available, so lanekeeper init and the wiki link were skipped. The values to add are at {path}
init.lanekeeper.failed: lanekeeper init did not create a config file. The values to add are at {path}
init.lanekeeper.blocked: Not written: {path}. It is a symbolic link or points outside the repository. Clear the link and run `lanekit init` again to get the lanekeeper values
init.hooks.set: Set the git hooks folder to .githooks
init.hooks.conflict: The git hooks folder is already set to {existing}, so it was left alone. Call .githooks/pre-push from that folder's pre-push, or move the existing hooks and then run `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`
init.hooks.failed: Could not set the git hooks folder. Check that this is a git repository
init.hooks.no-hook: No pre-push hook was placed, so the git hooks folder was not set
init.hooks.ask: To turn on the pre-push hook, pass --set-hooks-path or run `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`
init.gate.heading: First gate run (light)
init.relock.heading: Baseline lock
init.relock.ask: Baselines were not locked. Pass --lock-baselines or run `node scripts/lanekit/gate.mjs --relock all --reason "init"` to lock them
init.commit: Paths to commit (lanekit does not commit)
update.heading: Copy update: {from} → {to}
update.action.overwrite: {count} project-modified files to overwrite because of --force
update.action.remove: {count} files to remove because the source dropped them
update.action.orphan: {count} files dropped by the source but kept because the project modified them
update.current: {count} files already match the new source
update.no-lock: No copy or lock file found. Run `lanekit init` first
update.dry-run: Nothing has been changed yet. Run again with --yes to apply
update.done: The copy and the lock file are now at {version}. Baselines are unchanged
update.conflict-hint: Modified files stay as they are. With --yes the new source is placed under {dir} for comparison. Use --force <path,…|all> to overwrite
update.blocked: Some paths cannot be written, so nothing was changed. Replace the links with real files or folders and run it again
doctor.heading: lanekit doctor
doctor.crashed: The check ended with an error: {error}
doctor.P1.title: Required plugins
doctor.P1.ok: lanekeeper and wook-skills are installed and enabled
doctor.P1.fix: Install and enable each one from the same marketplace as lanekit with `/plugin install <name>@<marketplace>`. Needed: {plugins}
doctor.P2.title: Plugin versions
doctor.P2.ok: Both plugins meet the minimum version
doctor.P2.unknown: No version found in the install record
doctor.P2.fix: Update with `/plugin update`. Older versions lack the wiki link and the document search settings
doctor.P3.title: Session guards in personal hooks
doctor.P3.ok: No overlapping session guard in personal settings
doctor.P3.duplicated: Personal hooks still contain session guards, so they run twice alongside lanekeeper: {guards}
doctor.P3.fix: Remove those commands from hooks in your personal settings.json. lanekit does not edit personal settings
doctor.P4.title: Machine limits
doctor.P4.absent: lanekeeper machine.json is missing, so the defaults apply (3 lanes, 2 heavy runs)
doctor.P4.fix: To use values that fit this machine, see `lanekeeper-config explain machine.lanes.max` and create the file
doctor.K1.title: Config file
doctor.K1.not-json: lanekit.config.json cannot be read as JSON
doctor.K1.invalid: lanekit.config.json does not match the schema: {problems}
doctor.K1.fix: Fix the listed keys. Accepted keys are in `docs/02-config.md`
doctor.K2.title: Copied files
doctor.K2.ok: {count} copied files match the lock file
doctor.K2.no-lock: scripts/lanekit/ or its lock file is missing
doctor.K2.missing: Files are missing from the copy: {files}
doctor.K2.fix-modified: Express project needs in lanekit.config.json, not in the copy. Modified files are skipped by update
doctor.K3.title: Copy version
doctor.K3.no-lock: No lock file, so versions cannot be compared
doctor.K3.newer: Installed lanekit {installed} is newer than the copy {copied}
doctor.K4.title: Baselines
doctor.K4.none: No check is in ratchet mode
doctor.K4.absent: In ratchet mode but the baseline is missing or broken: {checks}
doctor.K4.fix-relock: If the values went down, relock with a reason so the gain cannot be lost again
doctor.K5.title: Relock log
doctor.K5.flagged: Lines without a reason, or with an increase but no decision ID: line {lines}
doctor.K5.edited: A baseline file differs from the last value in the relock log. It looks edited outside the gate: {checks}
doctor.K5.fix-edited: Restore the baseline file, or lock it again with `node scripts/lanekit/gate.mjs --relock <check> --reason "<why>"` so the log records it
doctor.K6.title: TypeScript compiler
doctor.K6.no-module: Not checked, the ts module is off
doctor.K6.absent: The ts module is on but typescript was not found. The structure check skips itself
doctor.K6.unsupported: typescript {version} cannot be used. Supported versions are {supported}. The structure check skips itself
doctor.K6.fix: Install typescript {supported} as a dev dependency. If it lives in another folder, put that folder in checks.structure.typescriptFrom
doctor.K5.fix: Review those lines of `scripts/lanekit/baselines/relock-log.jsonl` and their commits. Only the gate writes this log
doctor.G1.title: lanekeeper gate command
doctor.G1.other: gate.command does not call the lanekit gate: {command}
doctor.G1.fix: Set gate.command to `node scripts/lanekit/gate.mjs --profile light`, or add it to gate.append_checks
doctor.G2.title: Release gate
doctor.G2.fix: Add `{ "name": "lanekit-full", "command": "node scripts/lanekit/gate.mjs --profile full", "required": true }` to release.gates in .lanekeeper/config.json
doctor.G3.title: pre-push hook
doctor.G3.ok: core.hooksPath is .githooks and pre-push is executable
doctor.G3.not-used: The remote gate is none, so this is not checked
doctor.G3.not-configured: core.hooksPath is not {dir}, so the pre-push hook does not run
doctor.G3.fix-config: Run `git config core.hooksPath {dir}`. Each clone needs this once
doctor.G3.fix-chmod: Place it again with `lanekit init --yes`, or run `chmod +x {file}`
doctor.G3.crlf: {file} has CRLF line endings, so sh cannot read the hook
doctor.G3.fix-crlf: Add the line `{file} text eol=lf` to `.gitattributes`, then check the file out again with `git checkout -- {file}`
doctor.G3.index-not-executable: {file} is in git without the executable bit, so the hook does not run in macOS and Linux clones
doctor.G4.title: CI file
doctor.G4.not-used: The remote gate is {remoteGate}, so no CI file is checked
doctor.G4.absent: The remote gate is {remoteGate}, but no CI file calls the gate
doctor.G5.title: Evidence for HEAD
doctor.G5.ok: Evidence files exist for gate runs at HEAD: {profiles}
doctor.G5.unverified: Evidence files exist for HEAD ({profiles}), but some checks were skipped because a tool was missing or gave no result: {checks}
doctor.G5.fix-unverified: Read the skip reason in the evidence file. Install the tool, or run the gate again where a result can be obtained, and the warning goes away
doctor.G5.no-commit: No commit yet, so no evidence file can be found
doctor.G5.absent: No evidence file for a gate run at HEAD ({commit})
doctor.G5.rejected: Evidence for HEAD exists, but the run had uncommitted changes or failed, so it cannot back a release: {profiles}
doctor.G5.fix-rejected: Commit the changes, fix the failed checks, then run the gate again
doctor.W1.title: Document search link
doctor.W1.no-docs: No documents folder, so this is not checked
doctor.W1.empty: The documents folder `{dir}` exists, but docs_search.search is empty
doctor.W1.fix: Build an index with the wook-skills project-wiki skill, then add the docs_search lines that `/lanekeeper:init` prints to .lanekeeper/config.json
doctor.W2.title: Wiki index
doctor.W2.ok: The wiki index matches the documents
doctor.W2.no-check: This install has no wiki check, so this is skipped
doctor.W2.stale: The wiki index is missing or stale
doctor.W2.fix: Rebuild the index with the docs_search.build command in .lanekeeper/config.json
doctor.C1.title: codegraph index
doctor.C1.no-lanekeeper: The lanekeeper command is not available, so this is skipped
doctor.C1.no-line: The lanekeeper doctor output has no codegraph line
doctor.I1.title: Guidance file size
doctor.I1.fix: Keep only "read AGENTS.md first" in CLAUDE.md. Move long sections of AGENTS.md into docs/ and point to them in one line
doctor.I2.title: Machine-bound paths in guidance
doctor.I2.ok: Guidance files have no absolute path or localhost port
doctor.I2.found: Paths or ports that only work on one machine: {lines}
doctor.I2.fix: Use paths relative to the repository. Keep per-machine values in personal settings
doctor.I3.title: Duplicate guidance sections
doctor.I3.ok: The guidance files share no section title
doctor.I3.found: Titles that already exist in another guidance file: {lines}
doctor.I3.fix: Keep each section only in AGENTS.md
doctor.I4.title: Memory index size
doctor.I4.not-found: No memory index found for this repository, so this is skipped
doctor.I4.over: The memory index exceeds 150 lines or 20 KB: {lines} lines · {bytes} bytes
doctor.I4.fix: Following `docs/memory-guide.md`, move rules to AGENTS.md and decisions to docs/decisions/, and delete finished entries
doctor.E1.title: Denylist for a public repository
doctor.E1.private: The repository is private, so this is not checked
doctor.E1.absent: repo.visibility is public, but there is no denylist
doctor.E1.fix: Create `~/.config/lanekit/denylist.txt` (`%APPDATA%\lanekit\denylist.txt` on Windows) or set LANEKIT_DENYLIST to its path. Write one regular expression per line
doctor.S1.title: gitleaks
doctor.S1.absent: gitleaks is not installed, so the secrets check uses its 6 built-in rules
doctor.S1.fix: Install gitleaks if you need broader rules
